name: Robust Inside and Outside Solid Voxelization
definition: A voxelization technique that determines the inside/outside status of octree cells using a heuristic model, allowing it to handle meshes with holes and intersecting geometry, unlike ray casting which requires watertight meshes.
summary: Robust Inside and Outside Solid Voxelization classifies octree cells using cube map heuristics and visibility propagation, enabling robust handling of non-watertight meshes without ray casting.
